_rule: Count a plank when its end face is visible enough to identify (about half its height or more) inside the marked stack. Counted by eye at 3x zoom; columns left to right. Stacks outside the marked range (background, side views) are excluded.

plank1.note: Bottom of all columns cut by the frame; top-surface holes are not ends.

plank2.note: Staggered planks of mixed thickness; top faces washed out by glare; one partly cut plank at the bottom of the left and middle columns. Ambiguous by about +/-2.

plank3.note: Bottom row sits under the watermark. Separate stack on the right edge excluded (cut by the frame).

plank4.note: Mostly a top view; only the ends at the bottom are countable. Thin planks stacked tightly. Ambiguous by about +/-1.

plank5.note: Long side faces on the right are the same planks seen side-on, so not counted.
